sync.title: Sync
sync.notConnectedText: This vault lives only on this computer. Connect it to the cloud to sync it between your devices.
sync.needSignIn: Sign in to your MemoBrain Notes server first (Settings → Cloud).
sync.kindSharedText: Notes are stored readable on the server. Can be shared with other people and groups. Administrators can access the content.
sync.kindPrivateText: End-to-end encrypted on this device: the server never sees your notes, file names or folders. Cannot be shared.
sync.kindExisting: Connect to an existing cloud vault
sync.kindExistingText: Download a vault you already have in the cloud into this folder.
sync.irreversible: If you lose both the passphrase and the recovery key, your data cannot be recovered by anyone, administrators included.
sync.kindFixed: The type of a cloud vault cannot be changed later.
sync.noCloudVaults: You have no vaults in the cloud yet.
sync.connected: Connected. Your vault is in sync.
sync.passphraseIntro: Choose a passphrase for this vault. It is different from your account password and is never sent to the server.
sync.passphraseHint: At least 12 characters; a few random words work well.
sync.strengthLow: Too easy to guess: add words or make it longer.
sync.recoveryIntro: This is your recovery key. It is the only way back into the vault if you forget the passphrase.
sync.recoveryWarning: Store it somewhere safe (password manager, printed copy). It is shown only once.
sync.recoveryRetype: Type the recovery key to confirm you saved it
sync.unlockIntro: This vault is locked on this device. Enter its passphrase, or the recovery key if you forgot it.
sync.newPassphraseAfterRecovery: You unlocked with the recovery key. Choose a new passphrase now.
sync.regeneratePrompt: Do you also want a new recovery key? The old one stops working.
sync.conflictExplain: {{path}} was edited on another device at the same time. The server version stays in place; your version was saved as “{{copy}}”.
sync.restoreText: Restore version {{rev}} as a new version of this note? Nothing is lost: the current text stays in the history.
sync.disconnectText: Disconnect this vault from the cloud? The files on this computer and in the cloud stay as they are; the encryption key is removed from this device.
sync.encryptionText: The key of this vault is kept in your system keychain. Lock the vault to remove it from this device.
sync.autoLockHint: Applies to every private vault on this device: when it expires the key is removed and the passphrase is needed again.
sync.diskUnencrypted: The disk of this computer does not look encrypted. Your notes are stored in clear text here: turn on FileVault / BitLocker / disk encryption.
sync.signedOutHint: Signed out of the cloud: sign in again to resume. The link of the vault is kept, do not reconnect it.
sync.removeFromBrowserText: Remove the copy of this vault from this browser? Pending changes are uploaded first; if some cannot be, the copy is kept and you can choose. The vault in the cloud stays as it is; open it again from the console.
sync.signedOutHintWeb: The session with the cloud has ended: reload the page or sign in again from the console to resume. The vault stays linked.
sync.linkWarningKeychain: The vault is linked and unlocked for this session only: its key could not be stored in the system keychain. Keep the recovery key safe: you will need the passphrase at the next start.
sync.linkWarningIncomplete: The cloud vault was created, but linking this folder to it failed. A recovery key shown here is valid: connect the folder later with “Connect to an existing cloud vault”.
sync.linkWarningOther: The vault was created with a warning: {{code}}.
sync.cloudDeletedText: The cloud vault “{{name}}” was deleted from the console or from another device. This folder was disconnected from the cloud and keeps all its files. To sync it again, restore the vault from “Deleted vaults” and connect the folder to it.
sync.cloudDeletedTextWeb: The cloud vault “{{name}}” was deleted from the console or from another device. The copy in this browser is no longer synchronized and keeps its files: go back to the console to restore the vault.
sync.cloudDeletedNote: Disconnected because the cloud vault “{{name}}” was deleted elsewhere. The files here were kept.
sync.quarantinedN_one: {{count}} file in the cloud cannot be read on this device
sync.quarantinedN_other: {{count}} files in the cloud cannot be read on this device
sync.quarantinedHint: Their encrypted name does not open with the key of this vault, so they are left alone: they are not downloaded, are never taken as deletions and are tried again at every sync. If the number does not go down, see the log.
sync.conflictChanged: The file changed after this conflict was shown: the versions below have been reloaded. Review them and choose again.
